focus.title: Taper
focus.text: Less volume, a little intensity kept. The work is done: the fitness stays, the tiredness goes. Sleep counts as training this week.

pacing.start: First two kilometres 5 seconds per km slower than goal pace, then settle in.

before: For two days before: carbohydrate at every meal, about 8 to 10 g per kg of body weight a day.
Breakfast you know, 3 hours before: mostly carbohydrate, little fibre and fat.
during: About 30 to 60 g of carbohydrate an hour: a gel every 40 minutes from the 40th.
Sips at the drink stations, 400 to 600 ml an hour, more in the heat.
Only gels and drinks you've tried in training.

checklist: Shoes and kit worn in on a long run
Bib, pins or race belt, and the start time
Watch charged, pacing workout on it
Travel to the start, with time to spare
